FIELDS.NAME: Hobby Haven
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, Hobby Haven
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Hobby Haven operates as a retail store specializing in a wide range of hobby and model-building supplies. Our mission is to provide enthusiasts with high-quality products, expert advice, and a welcoming environment for exploration and creativity. We focus on maintaining a well-organized store layout with clear aisles and proper lighting to ensure customer safety and satisfaction. Our inventory is meticulously managed through regular stock audits to minimize shrinkage and ensure product availability. We also offer instructional classes and workshops, all covered by appropriate professional liability insurance to mitigate any instructional risks. All staff members receive comprehensive safety training tailored to their roles. We adhere strictly to local fire and safety codes and maintain essential safety equipment, such as fire extinguishers and first aid kits, to ensure a safe shopping environment. Additionally, we engage with the community through safe, supervised events and workshops, fostering a supportive atmosphere for hobbyists of all levels.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in the sale or rental of hazardous materials exceeding minimal regulatory quantities and confirms that our premises meet all local fire and safety codes. We maintain a clean safety record with no recent claims related to customer or employee injuries, and we implement proper inventory control systems, including regular stock audits, to ensure compliance and safety.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Theft of merchandise occurred on April 15, 2023, due to a break-in. The total loss amounted to $1,200.00. The status of the claim is currently pending resolution with the insurance company.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Sunday 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, Fire Resistant, Rated for Cash and Valuable Storage
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrol services with regular inspections of the premises.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Hobby Haven does not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose of, or transport hazardous materials in any past, present, or discontinued operations. The focus is solely on retailing hobby and model-building supplies with no involvement in hazardous materials operations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Hobby Haven sponsors a local youth athletic team as part of our community engagement efforts to support and promote healthy activities for children.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The responsibility for checking these certificates falls under the management team, specifically the Inspection Coordinator.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Hobby Haven has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes. Our commitment to ethical operations is reflected in our business practices.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Hobby Haven has not had any policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We maintain a solid insurance history and a commitment to compliance.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Hobby Haven does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff members are directly employed by our company.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Hobby Haven carries Workers' Compensation insurance as required for our employees, ensuring compliance with statutory regulations and safeguarding our workforce.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Hobby Haven also operates another business, Hobby Supplies Warehouse, which complements our primary retail operations in hobby and model-building supplies.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Hobby Haven does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The only current policy is HOBBY-2023-001, and no additional policy numbers have been listed.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Hobby Haven is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus solely on retailing hobby and model-building supplies.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Hobby Haven does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is solely on retail sales of hobby and model-building supplies.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Hobby Haven has not experienced any foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens in the past five years, maintaining a stable financial history.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Hobby Haven does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus exclusively on retailing hobby and model-building supplies without involvement in hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Hobby Haven does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations focus solely on retailing hobby and model-building supplies without involvement in hazardous materials or high-risk activities. We maintain a safe environment and adhere to all necessary safety regulations.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Hobby Haven has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring, reflecting our commitment to maintaining a safe and respectful environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Hobby Haven currently has no uncorrected fire code violations and consistently adheres to all local fire and safety codes.
